title: Video by zacharywinterton
description:
I’ve spent hundreds of hours researching design trends + tactics and there is one that people can’t seem to get enough of: Micrographics 🛠️

Before they were filling moodboards, their history dates back to the 1950s and 60s. These dense clusters of info were the functional design stars of a post WWII shipping and manufacturing boom.

Standardized information was printed on car windows, appliances, and electronics to meet strict international legal requirements.

Today they can serve as the hero of the graphic, or as a textural element, packed with symbols and typography that add instant depth to a layout.

I built out a fully editable Figma with 50 unique micrographic layouts for your next project, and I am giving it away for free.

Just comment Figma below and I’ll send you the link.
